'''Raxl''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] research assistant of [[Bant'ena Fhernan]]'s, and occasionally her lover, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Raxl traveled with a group of scientists to [[Taratos IV]] in order to carry out investigations. When they were in the [[Niriktavi Bay]], he was [[Death/Legends|shot]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces that were on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
